definitions.gloss: scheduled time; fixed time; appointed time
definitions.explanation: The predetermined or officially scheduled time for something to happen, especially for transport departures, meetings, or events.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}は{定刻|ていこく}どおりに{来|き}た。
{飛行機|ひこうき}は{定刻|ていこく}より{三十分|さんじっぷん}{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: The plane was thirty minutes behind schedule.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{定刻|ていこく}に{始|はじ}まりますので、{遅|おく}れないようにしてください。
examples.english: The meeting will start at the scheduled time, so please don't be late.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly used in transportation (trains, flights, buses) and business settings. Japanese trains are famous for their punctuality, so {定刻|ていこく}どおり (on schedule) is the expected norm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定刻|ていこく}どおり (on schedule, on time)
- {定刻|ていこく}に{到着|とうちゃく}する (to arrive on schedule)
- {定刻|ていこく}より{遅|おく}れる (to be behind schedule)
- {定刻|ていこく}{発|はつ} (departing on time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時間|じかん}どおり: on time — more casual
- {予定|よてい}{時刻|じこく}: scheduled time — more descriptive
